name: BMW R75/5 and /6
engine: 745 cc air-cooled boxer twin, two Bing carbs, shaft drive
intro: The /5 and /6 airheads. Tough engines. The charging parts and starter relay cause most trouble.

add.title: Check the diode board
add.instructions: With the battery disconnected, take off the front cover. Check the solder joints on the large diodes, the ground wires and the rubber mounts.
add.reason: Diode board failures usually start at a cracked solder joint on a power diode.

F: The /5 starter relay can act like a weak battery. Check it before buying a new battery.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Diode board
known.what: Most diode board failures are at the solder joints of the large power diodes.
